verses.original: אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃ וַיַּ֥עַן
verses.transliteration: ’î·yō·wḇ way·yō·mar way·ya·‘an
verses.literal: Then Job . . . answered

verses.original: עַד־ אָ֭נָה תּוֹגְי֣וּן נַפְשִׁ֑י וּֽתְדַכְּאוּנַ֥נִי בְמִלִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ- ’ā·nāh tō·wḡ·yūn nap̄·šî ū·ṯə·ḏak·kə·’ū·na·nî ḇə·mil·lîm
verses.literal: How long . . . will you torment me and crush me with [your] words

verses.original: עֶ֣שֶׂר פְּ֭עָמִים זֶ֤ה תַּכְלִימ֑וּנִי לֹֽא־ תֵ֝בֹ֗שׁוּ תַּהְכְּרוּ־ לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ‘e·śer pə·‘ā·mîm zeh taḵ·lî·mū·nî lō- ṯê·ḇō·šū tah·kə·rū- lî
verses.literal: Ten times now you have reproached me vvv you shamelessly mistreat me

verses.original: וְאַף־ אָמְנָ֥ם שָׁגִ֑יתִי מְשׁוּגָתִֽי׃ תָּלִ֥ין אִ֝תִּ֗י
verses.transliteration: wə·’ap̄- ’ā·mə·nām šā·ḡî·ṯî mə·šū·ḡā·ṯî tā·lîn ’it·tî
verses.literal: Even if vvv I have truly gone astray my error concerns me alone

verses.original: אִם־ אָ֭מְנָם תַּגְדִּ֑ילוּ עָלַ֣י חֶרְפָּתִּֽי׃ וְתוֹכִ֥יחוּ עָ֝לַ֗י
verses.transliteration: ’im- ’ā·mə·nām taḡ·dî·lū ‘ā·lay ḥɛr·på̄t·tī wə·ṯō·w·ḵî·ḥū ‘ā·lay
verses.literal: If indeed you would exalt [yourselves] above me and use my disgrace . . . against me

verses.original: אֵ֭פוֹ דְּֽעוּ־ כִּי־ אֱל֣וֹהַּ עִוְּתָ֑נִי וּ֝מְצוּד֗וֹ הִקִּֽיף׃ עָלַ֥י
verses.transliteration: ’ê·p̄ōw də·‘ū- kî- ’ĕ·lō·w·ah ‘iw·wə·ṯā·nî ū·mə·ṣū·ḏōw hiq·qîp̄ ‘ā·lay
verses.literal: then understand that it is God who has wronged me and drawn His net around me

verses.original: הֵ֤ן אֶצְעַ֣ק חָ֭מָס וְלֹ֣א אֵעָנֶ֑ה אֲ֝שַׁוַּ֗ע וְאֵ֣ין מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: hên ’eṣ·‘aq ḥā·mās wə·lō ’ê·‘ā·neh ’ă·šaw·wa‘ wə·’ên miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: Though I cry out Violence I get no response though I call for help there is no justice

verses.original: גָ֭דַר אָרְחִ֣י וְלֹ֣א אֶעֱב֑וֹר וְעַ֥ל יָשִֽׂים׃ נְ֝תִיבוֹתַ֗י חֹ֣שֶׁךְ
verses.transliteration: ḡā·ḏar ’ā·rə·ḥî wə·lō ’e·‘ĕ·ḇō·wr wə·‘al yā·śîm nə·ṯî·ḇō·w·ṯay ḥō·šeḵ
verses.literal: He has blocked my way so I cannot pass He has veiled . . . my paths with darkness

verses.original: הִפְשִׁ֑יט כְּ֭בוֹדִי מֵעָלַ֣י וַ֝יָּ֗סַר עֲטֶ֣רֶת רֹאשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: hip̄·šîṭ kə·ḇō·w·ḏî mê·‘ā·lay way·yā·sar ‘ă·ṭe·reṯ rō·šî
verses.literal: He has stripped me of my honor . . . and removed the crown from my head

verses.original: יִתְּצֵ֣נִי סָ֭בִיב וָאֵלַ֑ךְ וַיַּסַּ֥ע תִּקְוָתִֽי׃ כָּ֝עֵ֗ץ
verses.transliteration: yit·tə·ṣê·nî sā·ḇîḇ wā·’ê·laḵ way·yas·sa‘ tiq·wā·ṯî kā·‘êṣ
verses.literal: He tears me down on every side until I am gone He uproots my hope like a tree

verses.original: אַפּ֑וֹ וַיַּ֣חַר עָלַ֣י וַיַּחְשְׁבֵ֖נִי ל֣וֹ כְצָרָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ’ap·pōw way·ya·ḥar ‘ā·lay way·yaḥ·šə·ḇê·nî lōw ḵə·ṣā·rāw
verses.literal: His anger burns against me and He counts me among His enemies

verses.original: גְדוּדָ֗יו יָ֘בֹ֤אוּ יַ֤חַד׀ וַיָּסֹ֣לּוּ דַּרְכָּ֑ם עָלַ֣י וַיַּחֲנ֖וּ סָבִ֣יב לְאָהֳלִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ḡə·ḏū·ḏāw yā·ḇō·’ū ya·ḥaḏ way·yā·sōl·lū dar·kām ‘ā·lay way·ya·ḥă·nū sā·ḇîḇ lə·’ā·ho·lî
verses.literal: His troops advance together they construct a ramp against me and encamp around my tent

verses.original: הִרְחִ֑יק אַ֭חַי מֵעָלַ֣י וְ֝יֹדְעַ֗י אַךְ־ זָ֥רוּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.transliteration: hir·ḥîq ’a·ḥay mê·‘ā·lay wə·yō·ḏə·‘ay ’aḵ- zā·rū mim·men·nî
verses.literal: He has removed my brothers from me my acquaintances . . . have abandoned me

verses.original: קְרוֹבָ֑י חָדְל֥וּ וּֽמְיֻדָּעַ֥י שְׁכֵחֽוּנִי׃
verses.transliteration: qə·rō·w·ḇāy ḥā·ḏə·lū ū·mə·yud·dā·‘ay šə·ḵê·ḥū·nî
verses.literal: My kinsmen have failed me and my friends have forgotten me

verses.original: בֵיתִ֣י גָּ֘רֵ֤י וְ֭אַמְהֹתַי תַּחְשְׁבֻ֑נִי לְזָ֣ר הָיִ֥יתִי נָ֝כְרִ֗י בְעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ḇê·ṯî gā·rê wə·’am·hō·ṯay taḥ·šə·ḇu·nî lə·zār hā·yî·ṯî nā·ḵə·rî ḇə·‘ê·nê·hem
verses.literal: My guests and maidservants count me as a stranger I am a foreigner in their sight

verses.original: קָ֭רָאתִי לְעַבְדִּ֣י וְלֹ֣א יַעֲנֶ֑ה אֶתְחַנֶּן־ לֽוֹ׃ בְּמוֹ־ פִ֝֗י
verses.transliteration: qā·rā·ṯî lə·‘aḇ·dî wə·lō ya·‘ă·neh ’eṯ·ḥan·nen- lōw bə·mōw- p̄î
verses.literal: I call for my servant but he does not answer though I implore him with my own mouth

verses.original: ר֭וּחִֽי זָ֣רָה לְאִשְׁתִּ֑י וְ֝חַנֹּתִ֗י לִבְנֵ֥י בִטְנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: rū·ḥî zā·rāh lə·’iš·tî wə·ḥan·nō·ṯî liḇ·nê ḇiṭ·nî
verses.literal: My breath is repulsive to my wife and I am loathsome to my own family . . .

verses.original: גַּם־ עֲ֭וִילִים מָ֣אֲסוּ בִ֑י אָ֝ק֗וּמָה וַיְדַבְּרוּ־ בִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: gam- ‘ă·wî·lîm mā·’ă·sū ḇî ’ā·qū·māh way·ḏab·bə·rū- ḇî
verses.literal: Even little boys scorn me when I appear they deride me

verses.original: כָּל־ מְתֵ֣י סוֹדִ֑י תִּֽ֭עֲבוּנִי וְזֶֽה־ אָ֝הַ֗בְתִּי נֶהְפְּכוּ־ בִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- mə·ṯê sō·w·ḏî ti·‘ă·ḇū·nî wə·zeh- ’ā·haḇ·tî neh·pə·ḵū- ḇî
verses.literal: All my best friends . . . despise me and those I love have turned against me

verses.original: בְּעוֹרִ֣י וּ֭בִבְשָׂרִי דָּבְקָ֣ה עַצְמִ֑י וָ֝אֶתְמַלְּטָ֗ה בְּע֣וֹר שִׁנָּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: bə·‘ō·w·rî ū·ḇiḇ·śā·rî dā·ḇə·qāh ‘aṣ·mî wā·’eṯ·mal·lə·ṭāh bə·‘ō·wr šin·nāy
verses.literal: My skin and flesh cling to my bones I have escaped by the skin of my teeth

verses.original: חָנֻּ֬נִי רֵעָ֑י חָנֻּ֣נִי אַתֶּ֣ם כִּ֥י יַד־ אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ נָ֣גְעָה בִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ḥān·nu·nî rê·‘āy ḥān·nu·nî ’at·tem kî yaḏ- ’ĕ·lō·w·ah nā·ḡə·‘āh bî
verses.literal: Have pity on me my friends have pity . . . for the hand of God has struck me

verses.original: לָ֭מָּה תִּרְדְּפֻ֣נִי כְמוֹ־ אֵ֑ל לֹ֣א תִשְׂבָּֽעוּ׃ וּ֝מִבְּשָׂרִ֗י
verses.transliteration: lām·māh tir·də·p̄u·nî ḵə·mōw- ’êl lō ṯiś·bā·‘ū ū·mib·bə·śā·rî
verses.literal: Why do you persecute me as God does Will you never get enough of my flesh

verses.original: מִֽי־ יִתֵּ֣ן אֵ֭פוֹ מִלָּ֑י מִֽי־ יִתֵּ֖ן וְיִכָּתְב֣וּן וְיֻחָֽקוּ׃ בַּסֵּ֣פֶר
verses.transliteration: mî- yit·tên ’ê·p̄ōw mil·lāy mî- yit·tên wə·yik·kā·ṯə·ḇūn wə·yu·ḥā·qū bas·sê·p̄er
verses.literal: I wish . . . . . . that my words . . . . . . were recorded and inscribed in a book

verses.original: בַּרְזֶ֥ל בְּעֵט־ וְעֹפָ֑רֶת יֵחָצְבֽוּן׃ בַּצּ֥וּר לָ֝עַ֗ד
verses.transliteration: bar·zel bə·‘êṭ- wə·‘ō·p̄ā·reṯ yê·ḥā·ṣə·ḇūn baṣ·ṣūr lā·‘aḏ
verses.literal: by an iron stylus on lead or chiseled in stone forever

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֣י יָ֭דַעְתִּי גֹּ֣אֲלִי חָ֑י וְ֝אַחֲר֗וֹן יָקֽוּם׃ עַל־ עָפָ֥ר
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî yā·ḏa‘·tî gō·’ă·lî ḥāy wə·’a·ḥă·rō·wn yā·qūm ‘al- ‘ā·p̄ār
verses.literal: But I know that my Redeemer lives and in the end He will stand upon the earth

verses.original: וְאַחַ֣ר ע֭וֹרִֽי נִקְּפוּ־ זֹ֑את וּ֝מִבְּשָׂרִ֗י אֶֽחֱזֶ֥ה אֱלֽוֹהַּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’a·ḥar ‘ō·w·rî niq·qə·p̄ū- zōṯ ū·mib·bə·śā·rî ’e·ḥĕ·zeh ’ĕ·lō·w·ah
verses.literal: Even after my skin has been destroyed . . . yet in my flesh I will see God

verses.original: אֲנִ֨י׀ אֶֽחֱזֶה־ אֲשֶׁ֤ר לִּ֗י וְעֵינַ֣י רָא֣וּ וְלֹא־ זָ֑ר כִלְיֹתַ֣י כָּל֖וּ בְּחֵקִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî ’e·ḥĕ·zeh- ’ă·šer lî wə·‘ê·nay rā·’ū wə·lō- zār ḵil·yō·ṯay kā·lū bə·ḥê·qî
verses.literal: I will see Him for myself my eyes will behold Him and not as a stranger How my heart yearns within me

verses.original: כִּ֣י תֹ֭אמְרוּ מַה־ נִּרְדָּף־ ל֑וֹ וְשֹׁ֥רֶשׁ דָּ֝בָ֗ר נִמְצָא־ בִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî ṯō·mə·rū mah- nir·dāp̄- lōw wə·šō·reš dā·ḇār nim·ṣā- ḇî
verses.literal: If you say [Let us] persecute him since the root of the matter lies with him

verses.original: גּ֤וּרוּ מִפְּנֵי־ חֶ֗רֶב לָכֶ֨ם׀ כִּֽי־ חֵ֭מָה עֲוֺנ֣וֹת חָ֑רֶב לְמַ֖עַן תֵּדְע֣וּן שַׁדִּין׃ס
verses.transliteration: gū·rū mip·pə·nê- ḥe·reḇ lā·ḵem kî- ḥê·māh ‘ă·wō·nō·wṯ ḥā·reḇ lə·ma·‘an tê·ḏə·‘ūn šad·dīn
verses.literal: [then] you should fear . . . the sword yourselves because wrath brings punishment by the sword so that you may know [there is] a judgment
